headline: Fed Chair Powell, Sep 2024: *Not* the new pace
quote: I do not think that anyone should look at this and say, oh, this is the new pace.
title: Powell, Sep 2024: Is a half-point cut the new normal?
caption: Following a large half-point rate cut, Chair Powell clarified future reductions aren't guaranteed to match that size.
comment: How large will the next rate cut be?
